records.title: Real Time Information programme: post implementation review report
records.locator: Executive summary printed pp3–5; RTI performance printed pp11–13; methods/context printed pp6–7
records.population: UK RTI programme and stakeholders, not a representative contemporary payroll needs sample
records.fieldwork_period: Programme closed 2015; review describes implementation and 2016–2017 evidence; publication 7 December 2017
records.funding_or_commercial_interest: HMRC self-review; internal and external stakeholder inputs
records.limitations: Historical self-evaluation. Do not treat monetary benefits as a current employer ROI benchmark or selected stakeholder feedback as prevalence. Improvement and persistent exception work coexist. No trendline to CIPP selected cases.
records.reuse_status: Retained for private verification; final reproduction/rights review outstanding

records.title: Systemic issues in HMRC Real Time Information data collection and customer experience when seeking resolution
records.date_note: Date established by publisher release; PDF cover date field is blank.
records.review_status: original relevant cases read; case5 page rendered and visually inspected
records.locator: PDF pp2–9 introduction and seven cases; p7 case5; pp11–12 conclusion/history
records.population: Seven member/practitioner reported RTI cases deliberately illustrating problems; employers/agents include NHS and other business contexts
records.fieldwork_period: Case accounts span November2020–January2025; not a coherent fieldwork wave
records.funding_or_commercial_interest: Professional body advocacy; published HMRC response is on landing page, not independent case audit
records.limitations: Purposeful adverse-case selection; reported attribution is not an independent root-cause audit. No population error rate, current backlog count or deterioration estimate. Quotes about future expansion are expectations. Preserve positive HMRC response and case-level resolution evidence.
records.reuse_status: Retained for private verification; final reproduction/rights review outstanding

records.title: Quality assurance of administrative data used in earnings and employment from PAYE RTI
records.publisher: Office for National Statistics and HMRC
records.locator: Sections3 operational context,6 producer QA and7 strengths/limitations
records.population: PAYE RTI administrative dataset used for earnings/employment statistics, not an audit of employer payroll accuracy
records.limitations: Statistical processing corrections/revisions must not be relabelled a payroll employer error rate. Enhanced statistical assurance is not certification of every payroll record.
